pages.title: Markov Chains
pages.text: $(thing)Markov Chains$()$(br2)A process with no memory: where it goes next depends only on where it is. Run it long enough and it settles into a fixed share of time in each state.

$(thing)Insight$(): 70$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Probability Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 Dice Set.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A machine breaks with chance a on any day and is mended with chance b. Write the fraction P of days it works in the long run.
